1: // Simple Space Debris Dodge game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: // Sound effects
5: const collisionSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // short silent placeholder beep
6: const bgMusic = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
7: bgMusic.loop = true;
8: bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
9: bgMusic.play();
10: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
11: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
12: 
13: // Ship (drawn as a triangle)
14: const ship = {x: canvas.width/2, y: canvas.height-50, w:30, h:30, speed:4, shield:3};
15: const keys = {};
16: window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
17: window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
18: 
19: // Debris pool
20: let debris = [];
21: let particles = [];
22: function spawnDebris(){
23:   const size = Math.random()*20+10;
24:   debris.push({x: Math.random()*canvas.width, y:-size, w:size, h:size, speed:2+Math.random()*3});
25: }
26: function spawnParticle(x, y, color){
27:   const count = 5 + Math.random()*5|0;
28:   for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
29:     particles.push({
30:       x: x,
31:       y: y,
32:       vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*2,
33:       vy: (Math.random()-0.5)*2,
34:       size: Math.random()*2+1,
35:       color: color,
36:       life: 30,
37:       maxLife: 30
38:     });
39:   }
40: }
41: let spawnTimer=0;
42: 
43: let score=0, lastTime=0;
44: function update(dt){
45:   // Move ship
46:   if(keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x-=ship.speed;
47:   if(keys.ArrowRight) ship.x+=ship.speed;
48:   if(keys.ArrowUp) ship.y-=ship.speed;
49:   if(keys.ArrowDown) ship.y+=ship.speed;
50:   ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w, ship.x));
51:   ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height-ship.h, ship.y));
52: 
53:   // Spawn debris
54:   spawnTimer+=dt;
55:   if(spawnTimer>500){ spawnDebris(); spawnTimer=0; }
56: 
57:   // Move debris
58:   debris.forEach(d=> d.y+=d.speed);
59:   // Remove off‑screen
60:   debris = debris.filter(d=> d.y<canvas.height+ d.h);
61: 
62:   // Update particles (move & fade)
63:   particles.forEach(p=> {
64:     p.x += p.vx;
65:     p.y += p.vy;
66:     p.life--;
67:   });
68:   particles = particles.filter(p=> p.life>0);
69: 
70:   // Collision detection
71:   debris.forEach(d=>{
72:     if(!(d.x>ship.x+ship.w || d.x+d.w<ship.x || d.y>ship.y+ship.h || d.y+d.h<ship.y)){
73:       ship.shield--;
74:       // play collision sound
75:       collisionSound.currentTime = 0;
76:       collisionSound.play();
77:       // create explosion particles
78:       spawnParticle(d.x + d.w/2, d.y + d.h/2, 'orange');
79:       d.y=canvas.height+1; // remove this debris
80:     }
81:   });
82: 
83:   // Update score
84:   score+=dt/1000;
85: }
86: 
87: function draw(){
88:   // Background gradient
89:   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
90:   grad.addColorStop(0,'#001d3a');
91:   grad.addColorStop(1,'#000014');
92:   ctx.fillStyle = grad;
93:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
94: 
95:   // Ship (triangle)
96:   ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
97:   ctx.beginPath();
98:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w/2, ship.y);
99:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
100:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
101:   ctx.closePath();
102:   ctx.fill();
103: 
104:   // Debris (circles)
105:   ctx.fillStyle='gray';
106:   debris.forEach(d=> {
107:     ctx.beginPath();
108:     ctx.arc(d.x + d.w/2, d.y + d.h/2, d.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
109:     ctx.fill();
110:   });
111: 
112:   // Particles
113:   particles.forEach(p=> {
114:     ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(p.life/ p.maxLife, 0);
115:     ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
116:     ctx.beginPath();
117:     ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI*2);
118:     ctx.fill();
119:   });
120:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1.0;
121: 
122:   // UI
123:   ctx.fillStyle='white';
124:   ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
125:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`,10,20);
126:   ctx.fillText(`Shield: ${ship.shield}`,10,40);
127: }
128: 
129: function loop(timestamp){
130:   const dt = timestamp - (lastTime||timestamp);
131:   lastTime = timestamp;
132:   update(dt);
133:   draw();
134:   if(ship.shield>0) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
135:   else { ctx.fillStyle='red'; ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width/2-40, canvas.height/2); }
136: }
137: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
